So if I test the wire going from the alt to the battery before the fuse, do I get battery voltage or alt voltage. Or is it like > 12v, alt is ok; under 12, alt is gone.

If the car isn't running you should get something around 12.5v. If you test it while the car is running you should get around 14v. Alternators can still put out good voltage and be bad. Turn EVERYTHING on in the car and see if stays ~13v or above. A bad alternator can also put out too much voltage. Like 15v+ would be bad, but I've never actually seen it happen
